scenario: Comparing two `Time` slots across patterns compiles: comparison operates on the instant (LTIM.1.1.2), with no timezone involved. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. Named for LTIM.10.5 (timezone-resolution failure), which no step here reaches; nothing resolves a timezone.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

schema Event2 scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule compare_times:
    Event e
    Event2 e2 where e.fired_at < e2.fired_at
->
    log info "e fired before e2"
